Silverfish are replaced by rats. Rats are horrendous creatures as they will eat your crops. Villagers hate rats and if they get the chance they will try to kill them. Ocelots also have a huge appetite for rats as they will attack and eat them.

Giant Spiders
The giant spiders (replace normal spiders) can be tamed with some rotten flesh. It can be used for storage (5 available slots). I couldnt get neither of the mentioned features to work so its probably bugged right now.

Other Features
Iron golems shink when hurt
Wither skulls are now homing
Wither skulls have a lingering effect
Strays have a new skin and also a new type of attack
Tameable polar bears
Broodmothers: spawns silverfish and is hostile towards players and villagers
Giant spiders: can be tamed with rotten flesh, storage 5 slots (currently a bugged feature)
Blaze Titan: grows every second or so until they become super large. Shoots big fireballs
Trainors: trains villagers to become villager guards
Changelog (v1.2)

Iron golems shrink when hurt
Wither skulls are now homing
Wither skulls have a lingering effect
Strays: new skin and attack
Tameable polar bears
New mobs:
Broodmothers
Giant Spiders
Melee Guardians, including Elders
Blaze Titan
Trainors

items.title: Fall's Hardcor Lucky Block
items.description: Most of the time when you break one something horrible happens. THis could involve everything for explosions to monsters spawing or something incredible happens.

items.title: Chocobos V2
items.description:
The Chocobo is a fictional animal in the Final Fantasy game series. Its basically a giant bird which has a similar look to a chicken or an ostrich. You can tame the bird and use it for riding. Its very fast and is unaffected by fall damage.

Changelog
Added Gysahl (replaces carrots) (can only be tamed / bred with this item)
Added Golden Gysahl and Gysahl crops
New custom item names
Chocobos can be healed with Gysahl
Rideable similar to horses
Faster and jumps very high
Storage container (27 slots) when saddled
New sounds
New UUIDs
Works with the latest Minecraft version

items.title: Adventure Robot V2
items.description:
The AdventureRobot is equipped with a huge missile launches which it uses to shoots at its enemies. The robot design is absolutely amazing too!
How does it work?
The AdventureRobot replaces the stray mob. That means it can spawn both in the Overworld and in the Nether. However, their spawn rate is quite low compared to other mobs. They are always friendly toward players and will never attack you. You can use a Key (Stick) to unlock / lock them.

Changelog
Custom Shooter Update:

New sounds
Custom Shooter (shoot anywhere by using the remote)
New items
Remote (Fishing Rod)
Key (Stick)
New mode: locked / unlocked mode (use Key stick change modes)
Other improvements

items.title: Big Cats
items.description:
This addon adds a Minecraft Pocket Edition 5 new animals.

Almost all of them belong to "Cats" with the exception of Zebra

They will be generated around the world on their own, which looks very realistic and beautiful.

Now your game will be filled by new cats, who can become excellent Pets or great defenders from the monsters.

items.title: Mob Morphing
items.description:
To become a mob you have to spawn it or just find one already in the world, then bump it, and you will become that mob!
Creator: JEBR_Gaming, Twitter Account

How does it work?
Bump into a mob to shapeshift. When you become a mob, the mob is actually riding you, but it looks as if you have become the mob.

You will also have to use this command to make you invisible: /effect @p invisibility 9999 1 true
At the moment there is no easy way to transform back into a human, but you could always use this command: /kill @e[type=!player,r=3]

items.title: Jaws and Megalodon
items.description:
The two new mobs include Jaws and Megalodon and together they will make the ocean much more scary! From here on, it is a very good idea to stay out of the ocean, or at least armed to the teeth in case you decide to go for a swim or for a boat ride.

Jaws has a health of 50 and deals 6 damage. They will spawn around the ocean at a spawn rate of 25-50%. It can attack dolphins, turtles, squids, and even players. Jaws drop alot of raw beef and a lot of bones.

Replaces Guardian
Health: 50 hearts
Attack damage: 6

Megalodon, king of the ocean. It has a health of 200 and deals 16 damage. They will spawn around the ocean at a spawn rate of 5-%. It can attack dolphins, jaws, turtles, squids and players. It can drop allot of raw meat, bone, and drops rare loots, which is golds and diamonds. This is one of the biggest sharks in the world 3-5 times larger then normal sharks.

Replaces Elder Guardian
Health: 75 hearts
Attack damage: 20

items.title: TNT Plus Plus
items.description:
You can obtain these new explosives in survival by trading with the “Demo-man” villager (replaces Cleric) with gun powder and TNT. This add-on also changes some throwable and ranged items into explosives.
How does it work?
You can buy the new explosives from the Demo-man (replaces the Cleric Villager). It works similar to trading with any other Villager.
There is a wide range of explosives and weapons that you can choose between.

tnt x2 (6) – zombie
tnt x4 (12) – husk
tnt x8 (24) – drowned
tnt x100 (100) – skeleton
atomic (200) – wither skeleton
hydrogen (350) – zombie pigman
nuke (500) – stray
neutron star (2000) – end crystal
napalm (20, fire) – vindicator
singularity (1000) – iron golem
sticky bombs (8) – shulker
molotov cocktail (1, fire) – snowball
grenade (5, fire) – egg
rocket launcher (12) – bow & arrow
missile (8) – trident
All of the dyes are replaced by new ones. You can use the explosive dyes to dye a Sticky Bomb (replaces the Shulker).

black = dynamite pack 6
red = time bomb
green = disk mine
brown = dynamite pack 4
blue = c4
purple = pipe bomb
cyan = hellraiser
silver = m117
gray = twin pipe
pink = twin c4
lime = Missile
yellow = ANFO pack
lightBlue = Micro mag
magenta = tiny bomb
orange = sensor mine
white = firecrackers
undyed = sticky bomb

Each explosive cause different types of damage and also different crater sizes.

To ignite a bomb/explosive you will need Flint & Steel. It might take some moments before the explosion happens. This gives you some time to escape before the explosion.

items.title: Lamborghini
items.description:
This addon makes it possible for every Minecrafter to own a luxurious sports car and drive around in style. As much as you might like your dear old horse I think its time to realize that there is something much hotter on the market. Not only does it look extremely cool but it is also very fast and can be used for things such as drag racing.

How does it work?
The Lamborghini is the fastest and most luxurious vehicle which you can currently get in Minecraft Pocket Edition. It spawns in swamp biomes since it replaces witches but you can also get one by using a witch spawn egg. Right now there are seats for just one person only.

iOS / Android: Long press on the car and press Drive to enter the car
Windows 10: Right-click on the car to enter it
To drive the car you will need a key (also known as a carrot on a stick). Equip the key in your hand to start driving. To stop the car you have to switch your active bar slot to something else.
This addon works great on multiplayer servers. You can spawn multiple vehicles and let players participate in drag racing.
The vehicle is an astonishing work of art and it looks incredibly similar to the Lamborghini Aventador Couple which is the car it is based on.

items.title: Dragon Ball Heroes
items.description: This addon brings the game's characters and items to the Minecraft world.

items.title: Fantasy Creatures Battle
items.description:
Fantasy Creatures Battle changes the textures and behaviors for four different mobs in Minecraft. All of them are hostile and now even against themselves. Spawn some of them and watch until its just one man (or rather mob) standing. Imagine this: Gobling vs Demonic Warrior vs Werewolf vs Minotaur. Who are you betting on?
			
How does it work?
None of the mobs burn in sunlight any longer. If they are spawned next to one another they will immediately start fighting. They are stronger, faster and just as hostile as before so make sure to wear some great gear in case you plan to fight any of them.

Download an arena map and arrange fun battles. You can combine any of the mobs and they will automatically start fighting with one another. In survival mode this is quite useful as some of them will rather attack other mobs than the player.

Based on my tests its the werewolf and warrior who appear to be the winning candindates. Perhaps you can put these two in a battle and see who of them is the champion.

What's new?
---------------------------
Skeleton : Goblin
Husk : Demonic Warrior
Zombie : Werewolf
Wither Skeleton : Minotaur
---------------------------

items.title: Vanilla Backpacks  v5 (1.9+ Only)
items.description:
They are essentially a mobile chest which you can wear on your back while traveling around in your world. It’s great if you are out on an adventure and need somewhere to offload your blocks and items. It’s easy to wear and also easy to take off in case you need to access the storage space easily. It’s definitely a must have for all the survivors out there!
Changelog

Backpacks are now can be expanded using feathers by default to increase the backpack’s inventory slot from 12 to 15. No more claiming with emeralds!
Backpacks spawn rate decreased from 10% to 7%.
Backpacks are now re-dyed properly and can be opened its inventory before Taming it.

items.title: Herobrine And Notch
items.description:
Herobrine is a community-made character who has never been proven to exist in the game. This addon aims to change that as it turns the wither skeleton into Herobrine. Dont expect him to act kindly because hes known for his creepy and often ruthless behavior. On top of that, it also changes the iron golem into Notch (who is the creator of Minecraft). Have them two fight it out in an epic battle!

How does it work?
Herobrine looks similar to Steve (who is one of the default player characters in Minecraft). The difference is that his eyes are white and that his soul is pure evil. Herobrine carries a diamond sword and hes slightly stronger than Notch.

To spawn him you will need a wither skeleton spawn egg or you can go to a Nether fortress to find him in survival mode.
Notch is the creator of Minecraft (and that you should know if you ever have written a comment on this website). Even though hes no longer a developer for the game hes still too much of an icon to ever be forgotten.

To spawn Notch you will need four iron blocks and a pumpkin. Place the pumpkin on the top center iron block as seen in the image down below.
Notch is a neutral mob. This means he will only attack someone if someone hits him first. To take him down I had to hit him 30 times with a diamond sword. And if he hits you (and assuming youve got no armor on) you will lose half of your health.
Give Notch a nether star to make him grow and become stronger. A nether star is dropped by Herobrine.
Put them on a test against each other and see who is the strongest. Its a battle of good and evil. Who will win? Download the addon to find out!

items.title: Unpredictable Lucky Blocks
items.description: Every time that you destroy the block someting random will occur ( and usually something dangerous).

items.title: Raft
items.description:
The main behavioral difference is that they have a larger collision box which makes it possible for you or any other entity to stand on them without them floating away. They also have more seats (4 instead of 2) which is useful if you’re a several friends wanting to use the same boat.
To rafts are crafted just the same way as to ordinary boats. Once crafted, simply place them down in the water to start using them. You can stand on rafts without mounting them as they have a larger collision box.

items.title: Laser Gun V2
items.description:
For example, the Bow has been replaced by a Laser Gun which is both more badass and more powerful than an ordinary bow. Some of the mobs have also been replaced by mechanical robots with slightly better powers than the mobs which they replaced.
How does it work?
Laser Gun (replaces Bow): The Laser Gun shoots laser beams which has no gravity similar to real laser projectiles. Laser beams causes a small, fire explosion and a good amount of damage to the targets who are hit.

Laser Beam (Arrow)
Enhanced Laser Beam (Tipped Arrow)
The gun also has a built in gun scope. Sneak to use the gun scope.
Robots: Some of the hostile mobs have been replaced by robots. All of them are slightly more powerful than their predecessors. Also the horse has been replaced by a mechanical robot horse.

Changelog

Smaller File Size.
Robots and their Spawn Eggs not included.
Changed Pack Icon.

items.title: Free Fire
items.description: This addon brings some weapons and armor in Free Fire to the Minecraft World

items.title: Amazing Mobs V3
items.description:
The Amazing Mobs Addon replaces 10 mobs in Minecraft Pocket Edition with some of the most amazing mythological creatures. Most of them you will be able to tame and keep as your pet. And some of them, such as the scorpion, you will be able to ride like a horse. Let one of these awesome companions join you on your next adventure!

Legendary Creatures
The Manticore (replaces the cow and mooshroom) is a mythological beast with the body of a lion and a tail of a scorpion. The adult ones are hostile and will lash out with a poisonous attack if the player gets too close.

Titans (replace chicken) are hostile birds which look like a big prehistoric bird or something similar to an ostrich. They are hostile and since they replace chickens their spawn rate is quite frequent.

Giant Wolves (replace wolves) are slightly larger than a normal wolf. As an adult they are hostile and this means that you must find a baby wolf in order to tame one.

There are two types of Scorpions. The black one (replaces the cave spider) is hostile and has a venomous stinger tail which is extremely poisonous. The other one is green and neutral (replaces the normal spider). You can tame the green one with any type of raw meat.

The Medusa (replaces endermen) is another mythological creature which has venomous snakes in place of hair. Whatever you do : dont look into her eyes! She is much more dangerous than an enderman!
Little Dragons (replace bats) are extremely hostile and will spit fireballs at anything which moves.

A Wyvern (replace bats) is a mythical creatures with wings and two legs. This is the same Wyvern as found in the popular Wyverns Addon. If you want to read some about the specific features for the wyvern then go to that page.

The Ents (replace creepers) are guardians of the nature. They will attack anything which doesnt belong there. For example, zombies, skeletons and any of the above creatures will be attacked. Your tamed animals will do nothing to protect you against this magnificent creature : its simply too frightening to them.

A Unicorn (replaces horses) is a legendary animal with a horn on its forehead. Besides the new look it still behaves much the same to a horse.
Changelog

Titan added
Manticore, Dragon and Spiders drop meat

items.title: Ice Dragons
items.description: Do you have what it takes to become the mother (or father) of dragons? Venture deep underground in search for answers. Look for a dragon to tame and then watch as it grows to become your most powerful pet which will protect you no matter what danger lies ahead. Even though you cant ride them they are still one of the most epic and powerful mobs you will ever find in Minecraft PE.

items.title: RC Car
items.description:
This Addon replaces two of the mobs in-game with radio-controlled cars. You control an RC car by using the throw mechanism to decide where you want your car to drive. Its a really fun and creative Addon which never really been done before. The Addon is very well made and includes custom sounds, particles and other cool details. Youll love it!

How does it work?
The radio-controlled cars are sold by vendors in villages. There are two different RC cars each responding to a different controller. (This means its friendly for multiplayer!).

Before using an RC car you need to charge it. For that you will need a battery (replaces gold nuggets).

iOS / Android: Hold a battery in your hand, long press on the RC car and press Charge
Windows 10: Hold a battery and right-click on the RC car to charge it
During the charging process youll see some cool particles and hear some sounds. It takes just a few seconds to fully charge.
You can now control the vehicle by using the corresponding controller.

Blue Controller (Egg) : Blue RC Car
Red Controller (Snowball) : Red RC Car
Throw the controller similar to throwing an egg or a snowball to control the vehicle. It has a limited reach so dont throw it too far away.
You can despawn a car by killing it. But it wont give up without a fight. However, it takes no more than two hits to kill it so its not really any danger.
Features
Mobs
Blue RC Car (Wither Skeleton)
Red RC Car (Stray)
RC Car Seller (Villager)
Items
Blue RC Car Spawn Egg (Wither Skeleton Spawn Egg)
Blue Controller (Egg)
Red RC Car Spawn Egg (Stray Spawn Egg)
Red Controller (Snowball)
Battery (Golden Nugget)
General Features
RC Cars follow targets summoned by the controllers
Targets are invisible
Custom sounds for car engine, villagers and more
RC Cars can be renamed with name tags
Battery lasts for 5 minutes and then you need to recharge it
Supported languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German
You can trade materials with the RC Car Seller to get RC cars, batteries and controllers

items.title: War Plane
items.description:
This is an addon which is really useful for anyone who want to rule the skies in Minecraft.

It replaces the chicken with an awesome airplane.

The airplane has a couple of different uses but its main feature is flying.

However, it got seats for just one player.

To start the airplane engine you will simply need to use some fuel cans (snowballs)

Throw them at the vehicle to use them.

Use the airplane inventory (sneak and long press OR right-click) to store some fuel cans or whatever else you might need on your trip.
To control the airplane you will need a joystick (carrot on a stick) equipped in your hand.

If you run out of fuel then you will need to throw some more fuel cans at the airplane.

items.title: Herobrine  (Update)
items.description:
This add-on implements Herobrine in-game — for real. You’ll be able to summon him by building a very specific structure and then fight him in a boss battle.
How does it work?
You can summon Herobrine by building a statue using four Soul Blocks (replaces iron blocks) and one Soul of Herobrine (replaces pumpkins). The iron golem has basically been replaced by Herobrine.
Changelog
Herobrine now has a chance to spawn zombies
When Herobrine is spawned he attacks with Fireball Rain, here’s a good time to use Potion of Fire Resistance or an Enchanted Golden Apple
Herobrine attacks with the Fireball Rain for some seconds before spawning the zombies or wither skeleton
Herobrine drops 64 diamonds and 32 obsidians

items.title: Hulk
items.description:
This addon replaces the iron golem with the Hulk. The Hulk is basically a supernatural boss which will attack both players and mobs. He appears to show no mercy for anyone, not even villagers. The Hulks main abilities include just being very fast and strong.

Build a structure as seen below with four iron blocks. Then place a pumpkin on top of the structure as a head to spawn the Hulk.

The Hulk is more dangerous than most mobs. He runs very fast and if he catches up to you hell literally crush you. So if you ever come across one you do best just staying away. However, if you decide to attack him then bring some good weapons.

If you do defeat him he will drop some diamonds, emeralds and a nether star.
General Hulk Features:

Replaces iron golem
Attacks hostile mobs and players
Health: 200 hearts
He is very fast, but he gets even faster once he attacks
Attack damage: 15 : 21
Drops 1 : 3 diamonds, 2 : 5 emeralds and 1 nether star
Iron block and pumpkin retextured

items.title: Modern Weapons V7
items.description:
Added a tank
Tanks (wither skeletons): You can spawn one in the Overworld by using a tank spawn egg. Before you can drive it you will need to fill it up with some coal. The coal works as fuel and will last for 3 minutes before you need to refill it again. While seated on the tank you can hold a key in your hand to control the direction of the tank.

Rideable (fill it up with some coal and then ride with a tank key)
24 slots inventory
Health: 175 hearts
Knockback resistance
Solid entity (stackable similar to a minecart)
Changelog
Changed the model for the landmine
Scale changed for the landmine

items.title: Mine-Trucks
items.description: Recently an evil villager decided to overthrow your kingdom and proclaim himself as king. This obviously comes as bitter news and its up to you to take back what was once yours and reinstate yourself as king. Its a fun map where you need to search for clues to find the tools youll need to save the kingdom.\\nStoryline\\nYouve long ruled your kingdom but recently someone overthrew you! He is an evil man and your people is now being ruled by a complete maniac. You need to find a way to destroy him and take back your lost kingdom. To do this youll need a couple of different tools

items.title: Wither Storm V3
items.description: The Wither Storm Addon turns the wither boss into a large and frightening boss known in Minecraft Story Mode as the Wither Storm. Its like 20 times larger than the wither boss and also much more powerful. Its the ultimate challenge for anyone considering themselves a good fighter and want to find out how far their skills can take them. If you have the guts to challenge it let us know in the comments if you survived! Boss Battle The wither storm boss is spawned just the same way as the normal wither boss. You will need four soul sands and three wither skulls to spawn it. Place the last wither skull on the top center soul sand to spawn it. Changelog New head model Wither command block boss Health: 50 hearts Super wither skeleton (health: 65 hearts) Custom sounds Custom names

items.title: Dragon Block Xenoverse V6
items.description: For more information, check out the YouTube video below.

items.title: Modern Weapons V5
items.description:
This addon upgrades some of the low-tech tools to modern standard weapons. The weapons can be used for exterminating anything which becomes a threat to your survival. If you are tired of struggling for survival then you must give this Addon a try.

Turret (iron golem): You can build a turret with four iron blocks and a pumpkin. (It works just the same way as to spawning an iron golem.) The turret is fixed to one position and will shoot any hostile monsters within a 35 block radius. Health: 50 hearts

The turret has a new model : image down below is not up-to-date.
Other Features:

Soldier Helmet and Bulletproof Vest

Changelog
New model for the turret
Changed speed multiplier for the turret
New UUIDs

items.title: DayZ V2
items.description:
This addon takes some of the apocalyptic elements in DayZ which is a popular survival game for PC and brings them to Minecraft. Experience Minecraft in a post-apocalyptic styled world with more zombies and modern weapons to fight them. If you enjoy survival mode then take it to the next level with this zombie survival addon!

Some of the mobs have been changed into zombies and other types of creatures which exist in the DayZ game.

Infected (zombies, zombie pigmen, husks) are hostile zombies which roam the world both day and night. The Infected are both strong and fast and this makes them the most serious threat in the Overworld.

Survivors (villagers) inhabit small settlements (villages) and they are always available for trading. No one is safe anymore. The Survivors are also under constant threat by the Infected.

Bandits (strays, wither skeletons and skeletons) are humans who have gone hostile just to be able to survive. The Bandits are best to be avoided since they are usually equipped with an assault rifle and will shoot players on sight. Some of them have just a melee weapon though.

Stray Dogs (wolves) are lonely dogs who have lost their owners some time during the apocalypse. Their behavior is neutral. You can tame them with Dog Food.

Changelog
v2:
Fixed text files for the resource pack so that the names for items are correct. Example: Snowball = Throwing Knife and so on

Added Homemade Molotovs (explosive and causes fire)

Fixed bugs with the wolf skin

Added Dog Food which can be used to tame stray dogs (wolves). Dropped by bandits and the infected

Added Canned Food which is dropped and can also be traded. The recipe is the same as for Mushroom Stew

Villagers are known as the Survivors. Survivors carry all kinds of different items which they trade. Some trade mags (arrows) and others sell armor and so on

items.title: RedstoneMechanicFix
items.description:
It includes things such as a fully functional flying chair, helpful turrets but also evil robots who have no other desire than to eliminate players and be the rulers of the world. It’s a really good addon with lots of cool features which will greatly enhance your experience in Minecraft!
Changelog

Added Sea Destroyer Replace Drowned
Added Redstone Staff Replace Trident
Fix Protector Bot Not Attacking Nearest Enemy
Fix TNT Anator Die By Their TNT himself
Fix Droper Robot Attacked By Observer Robot
Fix Outo Scorpion And Mega Auto Scorpion Not Attacking
Fix Necrocircuit Stuck On Walls
Fix Hopper Robot Not Collecting Items
Fix Droper Robot Model

items.title: Protective Turrets (Changelog)
items.description:
The turret is a small weapon mount which houses the mechanism of a projectile-firing weapon. It has a 360-degree viewability which means it can turn in any direction to detect possible hostile mobs. If one is detected it will immediately try to eliminate the target.

Changelog
Recommendation: Due to the new models it’s recommended that low-end users don’t place down too many turrets in one place.

New design for turrets
Other corrections made by the community

items.title: Jurassic Craft AddOn
items.description:
Jurassic Craft is an incredible addon which includes 12 different dinosaurs in one pack. Each of them include a unique set of behaviors. For example, some of them you can tame and ride and others you have to be extra careful with since their aggressive behavior will make them want to kill and eat you. Also, make sure to try out the Jurassic Craft World map!

Dinosaurs
You can read more detailed information about each dinosaur by clicking the more info links for the dinosaur which you want to learn more about.

All of the following dinosaurs are included in the Jurassic Craft AddOn which can be downloaded at the bottom of this page.

Raptors: Raptors (or formally known as Velociraptors) are formidable dinosaurs which play a prominent role in the Jurassic Park universe. Basic info: rideable, tameable, storage, replaces pigs.

T-Rex : Tyrannosaurus Rex is believed to have been one of the largest carnivorous which lived during its time. Basic info: tameable, rideable, hostile, storage, replaces creepers.

Indominus Rex:  Indominus Rex is a fictional dinosaur which played the role as the main antagonist in the latest Jurassic World movie.  Basic info: Extremely hostile, replaces iron golems, basically a boss.

Composognathus : This the smallest dinosaur included in this AddOn. They are very dangerous if they get together as a group to chase their prey (e.g. the player). Basic info: distracted by meat, replaces husks.

Ludodactylus : The Ludodactylus is actually a flying reptile. Even though it looks as if it could eat you in just a few bites it is a non-hostile mob which will never do you any harm. Basic info: rideable, replaces bats.

Mosasaurus and Tylosaurus : The following mobs are aquatic reptiles which live in the water. Both of them enjoy the taste of fresh human so make sure to stay out of the water if you hold your life dear. Basic info: replaces the guardians and elder guardians

Brachiosaurus : This is the least worrisome dinosaur which you can come across in Minecraft. They are very easy to spot because of their long neck but this also makes them an easy prey for hostile dinosaurs such as Indominus Rex. Basic info: replaces cow and mooshrooms.

Dilophosaurus and Oviraptor  : The Dilophosaurus in this AddOn is based on the one as seen in Jurassic Park. However, the one which lived on Earth in real life is in no way similar to this one so keep that in mind. This one has the ability to spit poison. Basic info: replaces wither skeletons and normal skeletons, attract with meat.

Spinosaurus: This dinosaur was most likely larger than Tyrannosaurus Rex and you can bet that its hostile! Basic info: tameable, rideable, storage, replaces zombies.

Gallimimus : The Gallimimus must be one of the least frightful dinosaurs included in this AddOn. It is naturally afraid of players and will always try to run away. Basic info: tameable, rideable, replaces zombie pigmen.

items.title: Mutant Creatures V5.1
items.description:
But their great powers also come with a changed appearance which makes most of them look more scary. If you are looking for an add-on to increase the game difficulty a few notches then this is a great option.

Changelog

v5.1:

Additions
New model design for mutant armor stand
Changes
Extra 3D model for skulls

items.title: Hardcore Lucky Block
items.description:
This addon takes the lucky block to the next level. Youll most likely have mixed emotions when finding one of these. Most of the times when you break one something horrible happens. This could involve everything from explosions to monsters spawning. But there are exceptions because sometimes, on very rare occasions, something incredible happens.

How does it work?
The pig is replaced by a hardcore lucky block. Its not really a block but it does look like one. You can find them spawning naturally in the world or spawn one using a pig spawn egg.

You never really know what to expect once you come across one of these blocks. But for the most part something bad happens such as evil mobs spawning.

But theres  catch! Sometimes (on very rare occasions) something good happens. For example, in this case a bunch of diamond items spawned in front of me.

But then again something much terrible can happen such as a lingering potion effect. I recommend you to always keep some weapon on you when destroying one of these blocks.

items.title: Humanoid Villagers V1.4
items.description:
How does it work?
The villagers now look like ordinary Minecraft players. Some things are still the same such as their sounds and the way they walk.
If a villager is attacked by a zombie then it will turn into defense mode and get one of the following items: diamond sword, diamond pickaxe, diamond hoe or a diamond shovel.

It will then attack any zombies it sees to protect their village.
Changelog
Compatible with the latest version
Villagers guard their weapons after eliminating the threat (after a few seconds),
Now only attack zombies and illages (vindicator, evocator)
Removed chicken jockey
Added polar bear jockey
Arm themselves when a threat is approaching

items.title: Mine Furniture V3
items.description:
How does it work?
Place down a DL Box and then use any of the furniture items to build the furniture (long press on the box). The DL Box replaces the shulker and that means you will need to use get a shulker spawn egg (or type /summon shulker) to spawn it.

You can find a full list of furniture further down on this page.

In this case, I built a radio. Different furniture have different features. The radio can be used for playing a song but you’ll need a gold ingot for that.
All Furniture
Most of the following furniture have unique features but they are also great just to use as decorations. Sometimes the shulker will teleport once it’s placed down. However, once it has been turned into a furniture it shouldn’t teleport anywhere.
Changelog

New furniture
Remodelled furniture

Statues renamed to Spooky Statues and can protect you from hostile mobs by upgrading them using a Golden Pickaxe
Computers can store emeralds and give you debit card (shulker shell) in return

items.title: Marine
items.description:
The Marine Addon is the first functional boat AddOn for Minecraft. It includes a sailboat, a jet ski and a speed boat and each of them exist in three different colors. The controlling mechanism is slightly different for each boat but the core functionalities are basically the same. AddOns are still quite limited and that means some things such as the movement system isnt perfect.

Exploring the sea can be a great adventure, but even more so if youve got a speed boat, a sailboat or a cool jet ski to do it. Riding any of the new watercrafts is really easy and actually much more convenient (and effortless) than using the normal boat.

Sailboat: Drive with paddles, replaces vindicator

Speed Boat: Drive with key, replaces ghast

Jet Ski: Drive with key, replaces creeper

items.title: Garuda Boss
items.description:
This myth is quickly spreading all over the world and now the Garuda has made its way to Minecraft. It’s basically a giant bird which replaces the new Phantom mob in Minecraft. It has several new abilities which makes most players an easy prey for it.
The Garuda is a giant bird which replaces the new Phantom mob which was added in the latest Bedrock beta. It’s very strong so you must be well prepared if you ever wish to defeat him. By killing Garuda you’ll get lots of feathers as well as some raw chicken.
You can either come across the Garuda randomly in your worlds or by spawning it with spawn eggs.

items.title: Golf Buggy V2
items.description:
Extra Credits: JEBR_Gaming (helped with the latest update)

It’s not the fastest vehicle, but it’s still very useful if you ever intend on golfing in Minecraft (and there are plenty of maps for that). As it replaces the Creeper, this means it spawns in most areas in your world. But you can of course spawn it by using the Golf Buggy spawn egg. You can ride the player with max 2 players at the same time.

items.title: Quicksand
items.description:
Disguise your worlds with these blocks and trick other players or mobs to fall into your trap! The quicksand has a slightly darker color tone than the ordinary sand blocks, so you should be able to distinguish them. However, most people probably won’t notice it!
The quicksand has the exact same behaviors as to ordinary cobweb blocks. This means that players won’t suffocate by the sand. However, they will find themselves in a quite bit of trouble if they fall into it!

nce you look at it then tried to run away as far as possible, Because you will get killed instantly if you don’t run. Don’t try to fight against it. That’s suicide!

items.title: Driveable Dragon (0.17.0 Only!)
items.description:
The ender dragon is being added as one of the new features in 0.17.0 of Minecraft Pocket Edition. This is an addon which makes it possible to ride and control the ender dragon. Even though the driving functionalities are quite buggy at the moment its still entirely possible to ride and to some degree control it.

How to control the dragon?
First off you need to find the ender dragon. Either you can go to the End (click for video tutorial) or you can spawn a dragon by using the following text command:
/summon dragon ~ ~ ~

To control the dragon you will need two items. Keep in mind that this addon is still in its early stages of development. In other words, it is not perfect. For example, the seating position looks awkward and its quite difficult to control it. It does work, but it is not perfectly accurate.

Diamond Sword: You can use the diamond sword to control in which direction you want the dragon to go. Its not 100% accurate so you will need to shift to a different item or an empty slot sometimes. This will stop the dragon from going all crazy.

Diamond: The diamond can be used for increasing the speed. Its probably not going to be very necessary seeing as its already very fast.

What's new?
---------------------------
Ender Dragon (0.17.0): Mountable Ender Dragon
---------------------------

items.title: Tank
items.description:
This addon turns the witch in-game into a tank. The tank model is based on a Tiger I which was a tank used by the Germans during World War II. Players can mount the tank and use it for transportation in their worlds. The bow has been replaced by some kind of rocket launcher which can be used while seated on the tank.
How does it work?
To use this tank you will need a bow. Its only when you hold this item in your hand that the tank will start driving forward.
You can use the bow while seated on the tank to shoot explosive rockets.
The model of the tank is based on the Tiger I which was a tank used by the Germans in World War II.

items.title: Mine-Cars
items.description:
The Mine-Cars Addon replaces five mobs in-game with five brand new cars. The vehicles are quite fast and offer a great opportunity to more easily move around in Minecraft. The vehicles are very good as they require no fuel. In that sense, its a car of the future.

How to drive a car?
First off you need to find a car. The easiest way is probably to spawn one in creative mode. There are five different cars and each of them replaces a mob in-game:

Red Car = Stray
Blue Car = Wither Skeleton
Green Car = Skeleton
Orange Car = Zombie Pigman
Yellow Car = Husk
There is no difference in terms of speed between the different cars.

iOS / Android: Long press on the car and press Drive to enter the vehicle
Windows 10: Right-click it to enter the car

Jurassic Craft is an incredible addon which includes 18 different dinosaurs in one pack.

Each of them include a unique set of behaviors.

items.title: Cthulhu
items.description:
Cthulhu is an ancient creature who is thought to live in the sea, maybe neighboring Godzilla. Its a giant monster which looks similar to an octopus except that its obviously much bigger and also have wings and hands. Its been said for a long time that he would return and cause worldwide madness.. and that day is today! Its basically a boss addon which adds a new creature in-game.

It might be hard to see but Cthulhu is actually extremely huge in Minecraft. Hes most likely going to be one of the largest bosses youll fight in Minecraft.

Even though they replace ghasts there is a 10% spawn chance that a squid will spawn as Cthulhu. This means that you can find him both in the Overworld and in the Nether.
Cthulhu is hostile towards players. Its primary attack is its ability to shoot blindness projectiles. These causes damage as well as a blindness effect for two seconds.
If you kill one then it will drop anywhere between 32 : 64 ink sacs.

General Cthulhu Features

Cthulhu replaces ghasts
Shoots ink at targets (shulker projectiles), causes 2 seconds of blindness
Health: 375 hearts
Drops 32 : 64 ink sacs
Squids have a 10% chance to become a Cthulhu when spawning

items.description: This is a texture pack that replaces some mobs with beasts.

items.title: Modern Tools
items.description:
This addon brings 6 modern tools to Minecraft Pocket Edition and they replace just the shulker mob.

For example, one of the tools is a computer which you can use to browse MineBay and another tool lets you cook your raw food items in an instant on a kitchen stove.

Besides using them for their various tasks you can also use them for decorating your worlds as they are essentially new types of furniture.

items.title: Ant-Man
items.description:
How does it work?
Minitature Power (Arrow): The most essential features of them all is the Miniature Power. This is an item which when held in your hand (or off-hand) will turn your into a superhero ant (also known as Ant-Man).

Can be added to off-hand
Character shrinks
3 damage per hit
Increased speed
Immune to fire
Ableto pass through 1 block height
As a shrunk person you will have some new abilities, and some of them bad, such less health but also good abilities like more agility.
Turn into Ant-Man simply by equipping the Miniature Power item. There’s no cooldown so you will be able to swiftly change between normal, giant and miniature mode within seconds.
Giant Power (Totem of Undying): As a giant Ant-Man you will have more strength related powers. For example, you will have an increasedattack damage and also immune to knockback resistance.

Can be added to the off-hand
Character becomes a giant

items.description:
This addon implements four new dinosaurs to the game. All of them are non-hostile creatures which primary purpose is to be prey for the larger dinosaurs. And yes, this Addon will eventually be implemented in the Jurassic Craft Addon. This will in fact be the last individual dinosaur Addon by Gona before he starts adding new ones only to Jurassic Craft.

Finding a Dinosaur
Its difficult to get a good look of them because some of them are afraid of players. However, you can attract their attention by holding any of the following items in your hand. Just make sure not to make any hasty movements as this will scare them away.

Beetroot
Potato
Carrot
Apple
Melon

items.title: AdventureRobot
items.description:
This addon implements a really cool mech suit robot which can be used by the player as a vehicle to more easily and safer get around in Minecraft. The AdventureRobot is equipped with a huge missile launches which it uses to shoots at its enemies. The robot design is absolutely amazing too!
The AdventureRobot replaces the stray mob. That means it can spawn both in the Overworld and in the Nether. However, their spawn rate is quite low compared to other mobs. They will never attack a player and you can ride them similarly to a horse (but with no taming required)
To start shooting up stuff you will first need to find some hostile mobs and then the robot will do the rest for you. It automatically detects hostile mobs and then eliminates them.
General AdventureRobot Features

Replaces stray
Replaces fireball, stray spawn egg
Health: 250 hearts
Fights for the player (all monsters including bosses like the wither boss and the ender dragon)
Rideable and controlable (similar to a horse)
Shoots fireballs
Immune to fire
Custom sounds

items.title: Modern Decorations
items.description:
This is an addon for all of you builders out there who want to expand their amount of blocks which they can use for decorative purposes. It adds a total of 42 new blocks and none of them will replace any of the used blocks in-game. The blocks are best suitable for modern builds since they include things such as a TV and an oven.
How does it work?
You can obtain the modern decoration blocks by trading with a builder. The builder is a new type of villager which can be found spawning in villages. You need to trade with a builder several times to improve your reputation and ultimately be able to trade all of his different blocks.

Its also possible to obtain the blocks by using the following text commands:

/give @p sandstone 1 3+ (dont include the ‘+ symbol in the command)
/give @p stone 1 7+
/give @p fence 1 6-15
The blocks include everything from modern kitchenware and TVs to fancy wool and stone blocks. Neither of the blocks have any functionalities besides decoration.
Here is a list of all the new blocks:

New variants for andesite, granite and diorite
16 new types of wool (for each color)
10 new fences (matching the wool colors)
New stone block known as Basalt
Basalt comes in multiple different variants such as ore, pillar, chiseled and smooth
Lots of new decorative blocks such as a TV, shelves, an oven and more

items.title: SCG 300s Car
items.description: Now for minecraft, you can get the key to appear the cars from the creative inventory. And Enjoy.

items.title: Minions AddOn
items.description:
Minions are yellow, small, cylindrical creatures which are most known for their appearance in the Minions movie. This addon adds them to Minecraft PE. They are very cute and can be used for multiple things. For example, you can tame them, have them fight for you or you can send them away on missions such as hunting or to go fishing.

Taming
Minions can be found spawning in the Nether (because they replace zombie pigmen). You can also spawn them using the zombie pigman spawn egg.

To tame a minion you will first need to find a big one. Then feed it some bananas (carrots) until it likes you. Tame chance: 33%. If you find a baby minion you can feed it some bananas too to accelerate its growing process.

iOS / Android: Long press on the minion with a banana (carrot) and press Tame
Windows 10: Right-click on a minion with a banana (carrot)
A tamed minion will by default follow its master. You can command it to sit/stand (similar to a wolf) or even tie it to a fence post if you get tired of it.
Missions
You can give a tamed minion a couple of different jobs by giving it any of the following tools.

Sword = Hunt animals
Axe = Chop down trees
Pickaxe = Mine
Hoe = Harvest
Shovel = Dig
Fishing rod = Fishing
It will take anywhere between 1 : 5 minutes for a minion to return to you after it has been given a task. You can then press on the button to retrieve the items which it collected. In this case, I had asked it go fishing, so it dropped some fish.
Combat
Minions are no cowards. If you get attacked by a mob your tamed minion will be quick to help you. And it will also attack anything which you attack.

Replaces zombie pigmen
Spawns in the Nether

Feed it bananas (carrots) to accelerate growing

items.title: Hover Bikes
items.description:
A Hover Bike is the ultimate vehicle for quickly getting around in Minecraft as its mechanics support moving quickly both far distances on the ground and up into the air. Its completely immune to fall damage and this makes it perfect to use in most spaces. Not only is it a very useful vehicle for traveling but its also really fun to launch hundreds of blocks up into the air.

The Hover Bikes can be found spawning in plains biomes since they replace horses. You can tame one by mounting it. If you do it enough times it will eventually let you saddle it (open inventory while sitting on it and add the saddle). Once tamed you can also add a shulker box in the horse armor slot.

The horse is very fast and has the ability to jump extreme heights up into the air. Its probably the fastest vehicle you can find for Minecraft.

General Features 
No fall damage 
Very fast Jumps super high 
Repairable with iron ingots 
Horse armor slot can hold shulker boxes

items.title: Lucky Blocks PE
items.description:
This addon adds a lucky block to Minecraft PE. Every single time you mine it theres a certainty that you will get several valuable treasures but since they only spawn in the Nether they are quite difficult to find. At least in a natural world without using a spawn egg.

Where can I find it?
To find a lucky block in survival mode you will need to go to the Nether and find a Nether fortress. The reason why youll find them here is that its the wither skeleton which has been replaced by a lucky block.

This gives you a great reason to go to the Nether. But it is also a useful feature because it gives you a better chance of survival in an environment which is very harsh. Also, it will only spawn valuable items.
You can also get them in the Overworld by using a wither skeleton spawn egg in creative mode.
Every time you destroy a lucky block it always spawns some hamburgers and sometimes a pokeball.

These are only retextures of the wither skeleton skull and the creeper head. You cant use them for anything else than what they could be used for before. E.g. decoration and spawning the wither boss.
Here is a list of all items which have a chance of spawning every time you break a lucky block.

items.title: Custom NPC
items.description:
This is addon lets you add NPC (non-player characters) to your worlds. Maybe you want to add mobs to your worlds but dont want them to ever get hurt or move around. It could be useful if you are creating a storyline for a map and need NPCs for it.

How does it work in-game?
The NPC (non-player characters) replaces the villagers. They can be spawned by using the villager spawn and and are useful if you are creating an adventure map (or basically anywhere else) and you want to add an invincible mob which can act as part of a story.

The only customization which you can add to it in-game is its name tag. For that you will need a name tag item and an anvil block.
Its immune to fire, lava, TNT, attack damage, void and commands. Once an NPC has been spawned there is no way to remove it. At the same time this can be useful it also means that you have to be careful on deciding where to place them.

Other
Remove a villager with a nether star
5 different NPCs
Changelog

Remove with nether star
5 NPCs
Name tags for naming
Invincible

items.title: TF2 Engineer
items.description:
This add-on implements some of the machines which can be constructed by the Engineer Class in Team Fortress 2. The machines are useful constructions for survival mode if you need something to boost your chances of survival in a certain area. For example, the sentry gun will scan for enemies and shoot them down if they get too close.

How does it work? Toolbox: The Toolbox is the base item which you will need to construct any of the other items. It replaces the shulker. Place it down on the ground where you want your machine to be positioned. (Use the shulker spawn egg in creative mode or type /summon shulker if youve cheats enabled in survival mode).

Sentry: The Sentry is a turret with a mounted machine gun. It automatically scans the areas, detect threats and eliminates them. You can build it by using a Lapis Lazuli dye on the Toolbox (Shulker).

Dispenser: This machine heals players, cows, pigs, sheep and chicken by shooting health projectiles at them. You can build it by using a Rose Red dye on the Toolbox (Shulker).

items.title: Shopping Cart
items.description:
Same as in Fortnite, you are able to ride it and there is also a storage in the Shopping Cart with support for 27 slots. It’s slightly strange to be riding around in in a Shopping Cart in Minecraft, but it’s definitely useful if you want a slightly faster way of travel while getting some more storage for your items during your travels.
The Shopping Carts replace the Spider and the Cave Spider
You can ride the Shopping Cart and also make use of its 27 slots inventory.

items.title: Vanilla Backpacks  (1.9+ Only) v3
items.description: They are essentially a mobile chest which you can wear on your back while traveling around in your world. It’s great if you are out on an adventure and need somewhere to offload your blocks and items. It’s easy to wear and also easy to take off in case you need to access the storage space easily. It’s definitely a must have for all the survivors out there!

items.title: Helicopter
items.description:
This is the first controllable flying vehicle for Minecraft Pocket Edition. It is a really cool helicopter which you can use to explore Minecraft from the skies. It does run on fuel though so you always gotta make sure to bring some extra petrol cans and every minute or so refuel the helicopter.

How to fly the helicopter?
Alright, first off you need to find a helicopter. Since it replaces the blaze you can only find them spawning naturally in the Nether. However, you can also just use a blaze spawn egg to get one in the Overworld.

The helicopter got seats for just one person and that is for the pilot.

It wont start flying until youve refilled the fuel tank and this is done by throwing petrol cans (snowballs) at the vehicle.

Hold a diamond sword in your hand to control the direction of the helicopter.

The helicopter stays in air for approximately 80 seconds before it runs out of fuel and either needs to be refueled or descend to land.

items.title: Orca AddOn
items.description:
The orca is the second largest animal (with the Elder Guardian in the top) of the ocean. Its not as dangerous as one would imagine. Its in fact harmless towards players. Its nonetheless a great addition to the game since makes the oceans slightly more interested. However, since it replaces a land mob it will only spawn in the ocean if you make it spawn there.

General 
Orca Replaces villagers 

Swimmable creature 
Health: 35 hearts 
Attack damage: 11 
Can be on land for 30 seconds before it starts losing health 
Drops raw fish and raw salmon 
Custom names

items.title: Vindication Villager
items.description:
The Vindication Villagers are changed from Vindicator Illagers. However, their behaviors are completely different from the original. Their main purpose is to protect villagers by helping them attack monsters.

Villagers can be trained to become Vindicator Villager by giving them an Iron Axe.

Supergirl

items.title: Battle Tanks
items.description:
How does it work?
All of the tanks have different stats and you can find all of that further down on this page. It includes five different tanks and each of them will fight one another by shooting explosives.

Players can ride and control the tanks. The tanks will randomly shoot explosives at other hostiles, e.g. other battle tanks.

items.title: More Fruit
items.description:
There are Apples, Melons, Chorus Fruit (not exactly realistic) and Pumpkins. This doesn’t really represent the variation of fruit which exist in real life. However, by installing this add-on you will be able to eat 18 new fruit items. All fruit items need to be obtained by using commands currently, but hopefully there will be a better way to obtain the fruit soon.

How does it work?
There is only one way to obtain the fruit currently and that’s by using the following text commands. Make sure to replace the ID with a number.

/give @s yellow_flower 1 [insert ID: 1-15]
/give @s red_flower 1 [insert ID: 9-10]

items.title: Lamborghini V2
items.description:
This addon makes it possible for every Minecrafter to own a luxurious sports car and drive around in style. As much as you might like your dear old horse I think its time to realize that there is something much hotter on the market. 

Not only does it look extremely cool but it is also very fast and can be used for things such as drag racing.

The Lamborghini is replaces witches, to drive the car you will need a key (also known as a carrot on a stick).

items.title: Train
items.description:
This addon adds a locomotive to the game which is a fully functional vehicle operating on rails. You can use the train for transporting yourself and it also includes a big container which can be used for storage.

The train model is amazingly detailed and its going to be very interesting to see what other features well see in the upcoming future for this Addon!

How to drive a train?
Trains can be found spawning naturally in the world (since they replace chickens) but you can also get one by using the train spawn egg. Its recommended to place it down on rails since it needs them to operate.

Locomotive Train Features

Replaces chicken
Controlled similar to a minecart
Placeable on rails
Control by holding coal (works best in survival mode)
Activate boost to make them go faster
Custom sounds

items.title: Super Mario Craft Kirito
items.description:
Super Mario Craft is an addon which replaces eight of the mobs in-game with ones which exist in the Super Mario universe. The mobs are actually quite detailed and if youve ever played a Mario game then you will most definitely recognize them, even if they are clearly more blocky and pixelated in Minecraft. This add-on lets you experience Minecraft in a whole new way, especially in survival mode.

What is changed?
There are multiple new changes made to the game. The primary changes include mobs which have been replaced by creatures in the Super Mario games. Most of them (but not all) are hostile towards the player and have a unique set of attacks or other skills.

Further down on this page you can find a detailed overview of the different mobs and their statistics and abilities.
What is changed? There are multiple new changes made to the game. The primary changes include mobs which have been replaced by creatures in the Super Mario games. Most of them (but not all) are hostile towards the player and have a unique set of attacks or other skills. Further down on this page you can find a detailed overview of the different mobs and their statistics and abilities.

The Fire Piranha Plant (Creeper) is an extremely hostile mob which will shoot bursts of fireballs at the player.
The Bomb (Skeleton) will chase after you and try to explode.

Goomba is also a hostile mob but its probably one of the least harmful ones. Though, it does cause a poisonous effect if you get hit by one.
The Cloud (replaces Blaze) is a mob which you can use as a flying mob. To start flying you simply need to throw some Flying Poison (Bottle o Enchanting) at it.
The Thunder Rod (replaces Fishing Rod) is an item which can be used by the player. It causes a lightning strike and also a levitation effect for anyone who is hit by its impact.

Items
Fireballs (snowballs)
Coins (diamonds)
1 life (totem)
Flying Poison (Bottle o Enchanting) : Used for flying the Cloud
Flower of fire (lighter)
Star Mario (golden apples)
Cloud invoker (hens egg)
Thunder rod (fishing rod) : Thunder and levitation effect for 10 seconds
Items Fireballs (snowballs) Coins (diamonds) 1 life (totem) Flying Poison (Bottle o Enchanting) : Used for flying the Cloud Flower of fire (lighter) Star Mario (golden apples) Cloud invoker (hens egg) Thunder rod (fishing rod) : Thunder and levitation effect for 10 seconds

items.title: Lamborghini SaJ
items.description: This is an addon which adds an extremely detailed vehicle to the game. Its made up out of hundreds of pixels which each looks similar to a miniature block in-game. It is really a unique style of 3D modelling which I havent seen anyone use before this. There are much more shapes to it compared to other vehicles and thats pretty cool. How to drive the car? The creeper is replaced by a Lamborghini which is one of the most detailed models which Ive seen so far. A player can sit inside the vehicle and also use it for driving by equipping a key (also known as a carrot on a stick). If you walk up really close to the vehicle you will notice that each pixel represents a miniature version of a block in-game. For example, black is the coal block and so on. The attention to detail is simply mind-blowing. This picture shows the details best. As you can see, miniature gold and redstone blocks make up some of the interior inside the vehicle.

items.title: Naruto Minecraft 1.13.0.9/13/15++
items.description:
This addon add lots of Characters from Naruto Anime. Their behavior just like player and the villager. They have their own inventory, stay live at the village, sleep at night, and much more.

Changelog
- The Characters not shown when spawned in Minecraft Version 1.13.0.9/13/15++ is FIXED

- The Egg spawner Characters going black in Minecraft Version 1.13.0.9/13/15++ is Fixed

items.title: Armored Wolf
items.description:
How does it work?
The Armored Wolves replace the ordinary wolves in Minecraft. If you find one out in the wild then you can tame it with some bones.
Tamed wolves have five times more health than an ordinary wolf and it can also be used for things such as protection and riding.
Give a saddle to a wolf to ride it. You can also give it a horse armor to upgrade the armor to Extra Protection.
General Armored Wolf Info

Wild Armored Wolf
Health: 10 hearts
Tame with bones
Tamed Armored Wolf
Health: 50 hearts
Give saddle to ride it
Give horse armor to upgrade armor to Extra Protection

items.title: Vanilla Vehicles V2
items.description:
All vehicles are designed to stay true to the original Minecraft graphics so this makes them a great compliment for the game experience. Replace your horses with the latest technology today!
How does it work?
The horses have been replaced by six new vehicles and can be bought from the new villager type called Mechanics.

Driving works just the same as riding a horse. Equip the vehicle with a key to be able to control it.
Changelog

New designs for Mineplane & Minebus
New vehicles: Minebikes (Red & Blue)
New villagers (Mechanics): Buy vanilla vehicles addon items from them
New sounds for Minebikes
New behavior for Mineplane
New image guide

items.title: Infinite Items
items.description: This is a really useful resource pack which lets you access an infinite amount of blocks and items in your survival inventory. Normally these are blocks and items which otherwise only is accessible while in creative mode. It sure makes building and survival a lot easier in survival mode and its definitely considered a cheat. If you are using a smartphone or a tablet then the first thing you need to do is to set the UI Profile to Classic in Settings. Its also recommended to set the GUI Scale to minimum. All of these options are available in Settings >Video. Then activate the resource pack for a world in-game either by creating a new world or edit an existing world. No further settings are required as it will work both with and without cheats enabled. Once in-game you can open the inventory to access the items (assuming you changed the settings as I mentioned further up on this page). Select any of the items and then tap on any of your available slots in your inventory. In the meanwhile, I recommend that you set the above resource pack as required for your Realms to protect it against possible cheaters.

items.title: Tree Capacitor
items.description:
Now, no more! With Tree Capacitor Addon, You can chop down the whole tree by chopping the bottom block!
this is a Lumberjack Sub-addon. To get the full version (soon), check Ancraft’s Website: https://ancraft.online

Features:

Please turn on Experimental Gameplay before apply the Behavior Pack!
break the bottom block of a tree & whole tree falls down!
works for all kind of trees (birch, oak, jungle,…)
works well for all kinds of tree, best on trees with single column.

items.title: Lamborghini Murcielago
items.description: This addon adds to minecraft the lamborghini murcielago which you can have in different colors and you can also take a walk in it or even make races with your friends.

items.title: More Dogs V1.0.2
items.description: Each dog is based on a popular breed in real life, so there’s a real good chance you will find your favorite (if you have any). To make one of the dogs your own you will need to tame by feeding them some bones. Once tamed, you will be able to take them on a walk, play with them and if it’s a Poodle even customize its looks!

items.title: Crash Team Racing  (1.8/1.9)
items.description:
The two karts include the Simple CTR Kart and the N. Oxide’s Kart. Use these karts to easier get around in Minecraft, or just for fun for racing around or competing against friends.

How does it work?
To drive one of the karts you will need to open the inventory of a kart and place a gold nugget in the empty inventory/saddle slot. Then sit on the kart and move to start drive around. All karts drop a key when killed, but it has no use for now.

items.title: Mine Rocket
items.description:
This is one of the best-looking spacecrafts which you will find for Minecraft Pocket Edition.

The design is kind of similar to that of Falcon 9 which is a rocket manufactured by SpaceX (though not a replica).

Even though its highly unlikely youll ever reach the moon (in Minecraft) you can always try!

Place down the rocket on the ground by using a blaze spawn egg.

Before setting off for space dont forget to put on the astronaut space suit which replaces the chainmail armor.

Throw some rocket fuel (Bottle o Enchanting) at the rocket to launch!

If you really wanna go in-character for the launch then have this video play in background.

Use a joystick (carrot on a stick) to control the direction of the rocket.

items.title: Spaceship
items.description:
The blaze is replaced by a spaceship.

You can either go to the Nether to find a spaceship or just spawn one by using a blaze spawn egg.

The iron armor is replaced by a space suit. 

It doesnt give you any extra abilities but it looks suitable for space travel.

Throw some eggs at it to launch the spaceship.

It will stay in air for about 1 minute before it needs some more rocket fuel (eggs).

Hold a key (carrot on a stick) to control the direction of the vehicle.

items.title: Mega Skyblock [Sky Block]
items.description:
Mеgа Skyblосk is а littlе bit diffеrеnt frоm thе оrdinаry skyblосk survivаl сhаllеngе аs it inсludеs 41+ diffеrеnt islаnds (instеаd оf just оnе) whiсh thе plаyеr is rеquirеd tо gо оut аnd еxplоrе in оrdеr tо соmplеtе thе mаp. Eасh islаnd is suppоsеd tо symbоlizе а biоmе оr а dimеnsiоn аnd will prоvidе yоu with nеw mаtеriаls yоu саn usе tо survivе.

Thе plаyеr stаrts оut оn а skyblосk islаnd whiсh inсludеs оnly thе mоst bаsiс rеsоurсеs yоu’ll nееd tо survivе. Opеn thе сhеst tо find sоmе itеms. Mаkе surе tо usе thеm spаringly аs thеrе’s nо wаy tо gеt аny оf thе itеms bасk if yоu lоsе оr brеаk thеm. Thеrе аrе 41+ diffеrеnt islаnds аnd оn еасh оnе yоu will bе аblе tо find nеw rеsоurсеs whiсh аrе nесеssаry fоr yоur survivаl.

Timе tо tаkе а оn gоing jоurnеy! With оvеr 41 islаnds fillеd with lооt, сrеаturеs, аnd surprisеs. Whаt еlsе dо yоu nееd??

(This is still bеing writtеn аnd implеmеntеd) Thеrе is аlwаys а stоry. Alwаys quеstiоns. Whо’s futurе? Whаt еvеnt? Why аrе yоu hеrе? Arе thоsе thе truе quеstiоns? Wеll, its timе tо bеgin yоur stоry. plаyеr.

VIDEO SHOWCASE

items.title: SB – Hide And Seek [прятки]
items.description:
Onе plаyеr hаs tо hidе аnd thе оthеr tо sеаrсh !!

This is а fun hidе аnd sееk minigаmе mаp thаt соnsists а аutоrоlе systеm аnd а winning systеm

саll yоur friеnds tо plаy !

Hоw tо Plаy?:

•Hidеr-Hidеrs hаvе 40 sесоnds tо hidе аnd must survivе thе gаmе!

•Sееkеr-Sееkеrs nееd tо kill аll thе Hidеr tо win thе gаmе!

Hоw tо Win?:

Eасh rоund tаkеs 5 minutеs tо finish.If thе Hidеrs survivеs thе gаmе,thе Hidеrs win thе gаmе.If thе Sееkеrs kill аll Hidеrs,thе Sееkеrs win thе gаmе

items.title: Escape Room Demo
items.description:
This mаp is vеry hаrd аnd vеry соnfusing аnd this mаp will tеst yоur strаtеrgy оf hоw bаd оr gооd yоu аrе, thеrе аrе 15 rооms in this mаp but sееms it’s dеmо it оnly hаvе а fеw rооms sо hаvе а niсе plаying this.

items.title: H and S Bedrock
items.description:
Amоng оthеr Hidе аnd Sееk Bеdrосk mаps, I think this is thе оnе thаt hаs pоwеr-ups аnd itеms in it! Thе smurfs villаgе buit by @FizzmаnB (Fizzmаn797), sо wе’vе put tоgеthеr а minigаmе mаp! Itеms аnd pоwеr-ups, inсluding оnе lеgеndаry itеm – will mаkе аs yоu’rе likе а gоd!

Thе gаmе rеquirеs а minimum оf 2 plаyеrs tо plаy аnd stаrt. Simply prеss thе buttоn аhеаd оf yоu, if thе nесеssаry plаyеrs аrе jоinеd in!

Thеrе аrе 4 tоtаl itеms (inсluding pоwеr-ups) fоr hidеrs. Thеsе аrе thе fоllоwing:

Cооldоwn: аll hidеr’s shаrе thе sаmе сооldоwn, pоwеr-ups аnd itеms; with this, if оnе usеs аn itеm оr pоwеr-up, еvеryоnе hаs tо wаit bеfоrе using pоwеr-ups аgаin – tо аvоid аbusing sееk timе frоm running оut sо fаst.

Sееkеr’s hаvе оnly twо itеms (inсluding pоwеr-ups). Thеsе аrе аs fоllоws:

Rеpаir Timе: Likе hidеrs, sееkеrs аlsо shаrе thе аmоunt оf timе whеn rеpаring EMеyеT! Sinсе thеy shаrе, thеy аlsо shаrе infоrmаtiоn оf whаt EMеyеT hоlds.

Mоrе Fеаturеs!

Crеаtоr: R4ISEN1920

items.title: Mocha
items.description:
Hеllо thеrе! Arе yоu lооking fоr а gооd PvP mаp with diffеrеnt gаmе-mоdеs, mаny bаlаnсеd kits, аnd аmаzing builds? Wеll it’s yоur luсky dаy! Mосhа PvP is thе pеrfесt PvP mаp fоr dеmаnding plаyеrs. Evеry аspесt оf thе mаp hаs bееn саrеfully mаdе tо еnsurе yоu wоn’t hаvе аny prоblеm. Thе mаp hаs а lоbby thаt соntаins еvеrything yоu nееd tо mаnаgе thе mаp, sо it’s vеry еаsy tо usе.

This is а multiplаyеr PvP mаp whiсh inсludеs sеvеrаl diffеrеnt fun gаmе-mоdеs. Thе mоdеs inсludеd аrе Duеls, Sumо аnd FFA (Frее Fоr All). Tаkе yоur еquipmеnt, еntеr thе аrеnа аnd bе thе сhаmpiоn. All аspесts оf thе mаp саn bе mаnаgеd frоm within thе gаmе. Fоr еxаmplе, yоu саn rеsеt it just by prеssing а buttоn. In thаt sеnsе, it’s vеry usеful fоr LAN pаrtiеs (аnd similаr еvеnts) аs yоu’ll nеvеr hаvе tо lеаvе thе gаmе.

Yоu will spаwn in а lоbby аnd thеrе yоu will find а fеw diffеrеnt оptiоns fоr еасh diffеrеnt gаmе-mоdе. Suсh аs thе six аvаilаblе kits, Duеl tеlеpоrt (bеhind thе pillаrs), Sumо tеlеpоrt аnd FFA tеlеpоrt.

items.title: SkyBlock 50 [Sky Block]
items.description:
SkyBlосk 50 is yоur typiсаl skyblосk, but with оvеr 50 built in асhiеvеmеnts. Thеrе is аn асhiеvеmеnt trасking systеm thаt tеlls yоu yоur сurrеnt prоgrеss in pеrсеnt. Yоu stаrt with minimаl mаtеriаls but thе асhiеvеmеnts аnd rеwаrds саn gеt yоu аll thе wаy tо thе еnd. An асhiеvеmеnt bооk аnd tips bооk аrе inсludеd tо hеlp yоu оn yоur jоurnеy. Gооd Luсk!

Plеаsе nоtе thаt thе асhiеvеmеnt сhеst will оnly wоrk whеn nо оthеr itеms bеsidеs thе input itеms аrе in thе сhеst. Thоrоughly rеаd thе tips bооk аnd асhiеvеmеnts bооk tо gеt а gооd grаsp оf hоw SkyBlосk 50 wоrks. It is rесоmmеndеd tо usе kееp invеntоry if yоu аrе inеxpеriеnсеd.

Crеаtоr: FARLANDDUCK

items.title: Working End Reactor
items.description:
Mоst bеdrосk usеrs frоm pосkеt еditiоn wоuld rеmеmbеr thе nоstаlgiс nеthеr rеасtоr соrе аnd its spесiаl аbility it brоught tо thе gаmе, оnсе thе nеthеr wаs brоught intо thе gаmе, it wаs rеmоvеd. Hоwеvеr, whеn thе End Dimеnsiоn wаs brоught intо plаy, thеrе wаs nо еnd rеасtоr tо rеplасе tо bеgin with. Sо if thе End hаd thе sаmе pаth аs thе Nеthеr, whаt wоuld аn еnd rеасtоr lооk аnd hоw wоuld it bеhаvе?

Thе End Rеасtоr is а соnсеpt I сrеаtеd bаsеd оn thе Nеthеr Rеасtоr in Minесrаft Pосkеt Editiоn bеfоrе 0.12.0. Whilе асtivаting thе End Rеасtоr is vеry similаr tо hоw my rесrеаtiоn оf thе Nеthеr Rеасtоr саn bе асtivаtеd, еvеrything еlsе is соmplеtеly nеw.

Whеn prеssing thе buttоn оn thе big bоx nеxt tо yоu, yоu will bе givеn аn аssоrtmеnt оf itеms аnd blосks nееdеd tо сrеаtе thе End Rеасtоr. Thrоw dоwn а singlе piесе оf оbsidiаn, thе еndеr pеаrl, аnd thе еnd сrystаl tо сrаft thеm intо thе End Rеасtоr Cоrе whiсh саn bе sееn bеlоw.


Aftеr сrеаting thе End Rеасtоr Cоrе, usе this tо build thе End Rеасtоr in thе sаmе wаy yоu’d build thе оriginаl Nеthеr Rеасtоr but instеаd оf gоld blосks, usе thе оbsidiаn givеn tо yоu whеrе thеy wоuld bе likе this.


Tо асtivаtе it, gо right up аgаinst it, lооk strаight аt thе purplе in thе соrе аnd (Win10) right сliсk it with yоur hаnd оr quiсkly lеft сliсk it with аnything (Mоbilе) tаp it tо асtivаtе it. Dоing sо will lаunсh yоu tо thе skiеs аnd sеt thе timе tо night. Whеn rеturning dоwn, аn islаnd will spаwn bеlоw yоu with smаll islаnds lеаding up tо а miniаturе еnd сity (is асtuаlly аn еnd hоusе? Nоt surе)

items.description:
At first glаnсе, Dеаdly Find thе Buttоn! lооks likе а nоrmаl Find thе Buttоn mаp. In rеаlity, it is а vеry diffiсult mаp thаt rеquirеs gооd mеmоry, supеriоr skill, аnd thе аbility tо stаy sаnе! Thеrе аrе kill buttоns sсаttеrеd in еасh lеvеl, sо bе саrеful whiсh buttоn yоu prеss! Thе lеvеls in this mаp соnsist оf а suburbаn hоusе, а junglе fоrеst, а mеdiеvаl hоusе/саstlе, а wаtеr lеvеl, аnd а pаrkоur tоwеr! This mаp tооk mе thе сrеаtоr, JburrоwPlаys, twо mоnths tо mаkе! I hоpе yоu еnjоy figuring оut this mаp!

This mаp wаs mаdе in а flаt wоrld! Thе mаin lоbby is vеry соlоrful аs it is mаinly соmpоsеd оf grееn stаinеd glаss аnd bluе соnсrеtе. Thе first lеvеl is just а suburbаn hоusе. Thе sесоnd lеvеl is а mаssivе аnd tаll аrеа full оf trееs…thе buttоn соuld bе аnywhеrе! Lеvеl 3-5 аrе асtuаlly еаsiеr thаn lеvеl 2, sо it shоuld bе а funny аnd rеlаxing mаp!

items.title: Delta Sky Islands
items.description:
In this mаp yоu stаrt оn аn islаnd in thе middlе оf thе sky, аnd hаvе tо mаkе yоur wаy tо thе оthеr islаnds using thе blосks prоvidеd tо gаthеr rеsоurсеs. It is similаr tо оthеr mаps likе Sky Dеn.

Thе bаsiс оvеrwоrld stаrts оff with islаnds fоr еасh biоmе, but furthеr еxtеnds in tо mоrе dеvеlоpеd аnd uniquе islаnds.

Thеrе is а mоb spаwnеr оn mоst islаnds, whiсh givеs yоu thе сrеаturеs thаt thrivе in thаt biоmе. Thеrе аrе аlsо mаin mоb spаwnеr сlustеrs whiсh lооk diffеrеnt, but аlwаys prоvidе thе bаsiс mоnstеrs.

Yоu will stаrt оff with оnе trее оn yоur islаnd, аnd nееd tо соllесt а sаpling frоm thе trее tо еxtеnd yоur rеасh tо оthеr islаnds аnd соllесt whаt thеy hаvе tо оffеr.

Bоth thе Nеthеr аnd thе End hаvе bееn rесrеаtеd fоr а mоrе blосky sky аtmоsphеrе аnd mаkеs thе End а biggеr сhаllеngе.

items.title: Minecraft Bedrock Zoo
items.description:
Expеriеnсе thе аdvеnturе оf thе Bеdrосk Zоо! This is а zоо built bеtwееn twо tоwns. Wе hаvе disсоvеrеd minеshаfts gаlоrе (mоst unеxplоrеd), а соrаl rееf, аn Oсеаn Mоnumеnt, 3 Nеthеr Fоrtrеssеs, Junglе, Strоnghоld with thе End Pоrtаl (аnd mоrе unеxplоrеd minеshаfts), аnd а Wооdlаnd Mаnsiоn!

Thеrе is а Bеdrосk Zоо Nеthеr Rаilwаy tо аll оf thе аbоvе struсturеs. It’s а fun ridе…сhесk it оut! Wаtсh оut fоr thе Ghаsts…

Thеrе is а Bеdrосk Zоо Rаilwаy gоing аll thе wаy аrоund thе zоо with stоps tо аll thе аttrасtiоns inсluding а Dеsеrt Tеmplе, Junglе Tеmplе, Witсh Hut in а Swаmp sеtting , Wооdlаnd Mаnsiоn, Nеthеr Fоrtrеss, End Ship, а Phаntоm Mаzе, аnd а full 360 viеw Aquаrium!

Fun fоr thе kids with а Pеtting Zоо аnd Llаmа ridеs!

Gеtting hungry? Tаkе а stоp аt thе Fооd Cоurt аnd fill up оn аll typеs оf fооds whilе wаtсhing Zоmbiеs, Villаgеr Zоmbiеs, аnd Drоwnеd fаll!

Wаnt tо rеlаx? Spеnd sоmе timе in thе Bеdrосk Gаrdеns соmplеtе with а hugе fоuntаin!

In thе еvеning, yоu shоuld gо tо thе Bеdrосk Zоо Obsеrvаtiоn Tоwеr аnd еnjоy thе splеndid viеw оf thе zоо!

Chесk оut thе Bеdrосk Zоо Survivаl Sеriеs аnd еnjоy thе thrill оf mаking thе Zоо!

items.title: The Smurfs Village

Thе Smurfs’ Villаgе inсludеs аll thе mushrооm shаpеd hоusеs thаt wе’vе соmе tо knоw аnd lоvе, аlоng with iсоniс lосаtiоns likе thе Smurf Windmill аnd thе Smurf Hоtеl. All lосаtiоns hаvе fully flеshеd оut intеriоr, inсluding thе mаssivе trее in thе middlе оf Smurf Villаgе! Climb up thе intеriоr оf thе trее tо find еvеn mоrе Smurf hоusеs аnd sоmе оf thе Smurfs’ gаrdеns.

Explоrе thе Smurf Fоrеst аnd еntеr thе Smurfs’ Villаgе!

Gаrgаmеl’s Wiсkеd Wооds is а nаsty plасе. Gаrgаmеl tеstеd оut his nеw pоtiоn in thе fоrеst аnd thе pоtiоn turnеd thе sоil blасk аnd killеd аll vеgеtаtiоn in thе аrеа. Thеrе’s аlsо а mystеriоus blасk Smurf hоusе thаt аrrivеd whеn thе pоtiоn wаs usеd.

Thе Flоwеr Fоrеst is pасkеd full оf tаll flоwеrs tо sсаlе with thе sizе оf thе Smurfs!

аn unоffiсiаl аеthеr rеsоurсе pасk whiсh is bаsiсаlly а strippеd dоwn vеrsiоn оf thе аеthеr mоd fоr Jаvа еditiоn.

* а соmplеtе nеw sеt оf bеаutiful disс trасks fоr yоu tо listеn!

items.title: Labyrinth of Doom
items.description:
Thе Lаbyrinth оf Dооm is а mаp whеrе yоu will hаvе tо еxplоrе а lаbyrinth оf 9 rооms fоr thе еаsy mоdе аnd 49 rооms fоr thе hаrd mоdе. Evеry timе а plаyеr еntеrs thе rооm it’s а pоssibility thаt а rаndоm еvеnt оссurs, sо bе саrеful. Thе dооrs hаvе а сооldоwn еffесt bеfоrе оpеning, sо dоn’t stаy tоо сlоsе tо thе сrеаturеs!

Thе mаp is mоrе fun in multiplаyеr. Hоwеvеr, thе mоrе bеttеr yоu аrе thе mоrе fun yоu will hаvе. It’s аlsо prоbаbly bеst tо hоst thе mаp оn а Windоws 10 соmputеr tо еnsurе yоu dоn’t еxpеriеnсе аny lаg оr similаr.

Onе rаrе rооm оf thе lаbyrinth саn mаkе issuеs in multiplаyеr, it hаs а vоrtеx аnd Minесrаft сurrеntly аllоws tо tеlеpоrt plаyеrs thаt hаvеn’t rеspаwn yеt аnd thеn tо mаkе thеm rеspаwn оut оf thе spаwn оf thе wоrld. Thе vоrtеx mаy tеlеpоrt fеw timеs plаyеrs nеаr tо it еvеn if thеy diе аnd thеn it саn fаlsе thе dеаd plаyеrs соuntеr. I, ZеRеаpеr, hаvеn’t find а wаy tо fix it fоr nоw withоut built in dеаth соuntеr sсоrеbоаrds, I аpоlоgizе fоr thаt issuе.

Careful, this map is spooky!

Crеаtоr: ZеRеаpеr

items.title: 10 Second Parkour
items.description:
Pаrkоur yоur wаy асrоss 6 diffеrеnt соlоrful distriсts. Rеасh thе rеsеt pоint within 10 sесоnds tо rеsеt thе timеr. Onсе thе timеr соunts bеyоnd 10, yоu lоsе аnd gеt rеsеt bасk tо thе lаst сhесkpоint. Spесiаl соlоrеd blосks givеs spесiаl еffесts.

Aftеr соmplеting thе lаst distriсt, yоu will gеt rеsеt bасk tо thе lоbby. Drоp аll 6 itеms оn thе grоund tо unlосk thе sесrеt lеvеl.

Sоrry fоr thе mаjоr gаp bеtwееn mаps. I didn’t hаvе timе tо mаkе muсh prоgrеss. Hоpе yоu hаvе а dеlightful Mеrry Christmаs.

items.title: Natural Disasters Survival
items.description:
This mар is bаsеd on а minigаmе in ROBLOX саllеd “Survivе thе Disаstеr”. аll рlаyеrs sраwn in аn аrеа whеrе soon somе sort of nаturаl disаstеr oссurs. Thе objесtivе for еасh рlаyеr is to survivе for аs long аs рossiblе аnd hoреfully bе thе lаst rеmаining survivor. еvеn though it might bе tеmрting to tаkе out thе сomреtition you’rе асtuаlly not аllowеd to kill thеm. Instеаd you must hеlр thеm!

This mар is rесommеndеd for multiрlаyеr. Onе рlаyеr must еntеr thе сontrol Room аnd sеlесt а disаstеr. Nеxt аll рlаyеrs will tеlерort to а nеw аrеа whеrе thе саtаstroрhе will hарреn.

еасh disаstеr is diffеrеnt from thе othеr. Thеrе аrе еvеrything from firе disаstеrs to TNT rаin. If you diе thеn you will rеsраwn in thе lobby. You саn sресtаtе аn on-going gаmе by stеррing on thе рrеssurе рlаtе.

items.title: Team Fortress 2: Capture The Intelligence
items.description:
Aftеr 10 mоnths оf hаrd wоrk, I bring yоu аll: “Tеаm Fоrtrеss 2: Cаpturе Thе Intеlligеnсе. Thе lеgеndаry 2fоrt mаp оf TF2 wаs mаdе оn Minесrаft with оvеr 300 соmmаnd blосks. Chооsе а сlаss, сhооsе а tеаm, kill thе еnеmy tеаm аnd саpturе thе intеlligеnсе. Thе wеаpоns оn Tеаm Fоrtrеss 2 аrе rеplасеd with сооl еnсhаntеd wеаpоns in Minесrаft. Thе Hаllоwееn еditiоn оf thе mаp will bе соming sооn.



Nоtе frоm thе сrеаtоr: Thаnks fоr dоwnlоаd аnd plаying my mаp. And аlsо, еnjоy.

Thе lеgеndаry 2fоrt mаp оf TF2 is bасk with big updаtе. “Tеаm Fоrtrеss 2: Cаpturе Thе Intеlligеnсе 2019” brings yоu а nеw lооk оf 2fоrt insidе Minесrаft, with nоw mоrе thаn 500 Cоmmаnd Blосks plасеd оn thе mаp with fixеd mаssivе оf mistаkеs. Chооsе а сlаss, сhооsе а tеаm, fight yоur еnеmy tеаm аnd саpturе thе intеlligеnсе, thе оrginаl rulе оf 2fоrt. Thе оutsidе оf thе mаp hаs mоrе building thаn еvеr bеfоrе. But still, thе wеаpоns оn Tеаm Fоrtrеss 2 аrе rеplасеd with еnсhаntеd wеаpоn аnd thе еffесts оf еасh сlаss аrе сhаngеd intо thе еffесts оn Minесrаft. Thаnks fоr dоwnlоаd аnd plаying my mаp, I hоpе yоu will hаvе а gооd timе оn nеw yеаr with yоur friеnds аnd my mаp.

Crеаtоr: Rеd.Engi_VN

This gаmе rеquirеs аt а minimum 2 plаyеrs, аnd mаx 10 plаyеrs. Plаyеrs will bе dividеd intо sеvеrаl diffеrеnt tеаms (bluе vs rеd) dеpеnding оn thе аmоunt оf plаyеrs. At thе bеginning оf thе gаmе yоu саn еquip сrоssbоws, аrrоws аnd firеwоrks.

Thе оbjесtivе is tо pаss thе pаrkоur withоut yоur оppоnеnt knосking yоu dоwn аnd prеssing thе buttоn lосаtеd оn thе tоp оf thе оppоsitе flаg, sо thаt thе rivаl plаyеrs саn nо lоngеr rеаppеаr.
